thread:
alex: Quick heads-up: release train schedule tweak for the next two cycles because of US Memorial Day + EU bank holiday. Proposing we move the code freeze/cutoff 24h earlier on those weeks. Also planning a minor version bump to v1.18.0 on the next train. Thoughts?

maria: :+1: sounds reasonable. Which dates exactly? I'll update the calendar once we lock it.

alex: Cutoff dates I'm proposing: Tue 2024-05-21 18:00 PDT (originally Wed 2024-05-22). And Tue 2024-06-04 18:00 PDT for the following cycle. Release day stays Friday but may be quieter. If OK I'll create calendar events and toggle reminder flows.

devon: Are we changing the branch names? I assume release/1.18.0 and hotfix/1.18.x for patches? Also need to inform QA about earlier cutoff.

katy: Yep standard naming. Quick snippet for the version bump and branch dance:

```
git checkout -b release/1.18.0
# bump version in package.json / update docker tags
git commit -am "chore(release): 1.18.0"
git push origin release/1.18.0
```

I'll paste the changelog template into the PR comment and add guidance on formatting.

sam: Any change to the rollback window or hotfix policy? If cutoff moves earlier we should keep a dedicated hotfix window Wed morning (so QA has time).

alex: Good call. Let's keep Wed 09:00-12:00 PT as the hotfix window for release weeks. After that only emergency fixes with release manager signoff.

release-bot: Calendar invites created: "Release Train: 1.18.0" — Fri 2024-05-24 10:00 PT. Cutoff reminders set 48h and 24h before. Event: https://calendar.example.com/event/abcd (ics + email reminders).

maria: I'll ping QA and send the changelog nudges in #eng. Also adding a label `rc-ready` to PRs that should land before cutoff.

devon: @maria can you add a required check for release branches? i.e. ensure `smoke-tests` is required in branch protection.

maria: On it — will update branch protection rules after the coordinator confirms final dates.

alex: Thanks all. @sam can you be release captain for 1.18.0? You'll coordinate merges, watch the hotfix window, and own rollback if needed. DM me if you accept. I'll also update the release playbook with the earlier cutoff note.

sam: I'll take it. 👍 Will compile the release checklist (merge order, CI gating, rollback steps) and post the link once done.

devon: One last thing — if anyone has docs changes, please open a docs PR early. We had a last-minute doc delay last time and I'd like to avoid that.

katy: Adding changelog bullets now: "optimize batcher for small sequences" and "runtime kernel selection tweak for reduced tail latency". Will link PRs.

alex: Perfect. Plan for next actions: (1) I'll lock dates by EOD, (2) @maria update calendar & branch protections, (3) @sam owns release checklist, (4) @katy posts changelog entries. If you see any blockers reply here. :calendar: :rocket:

maria: Noted. I also added a short blurb to the release playbook about holiday weeks and earlier cutoffs.

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: cutoff reminder 48h before (Tue 2024-05-19 18:00 PDT) and final 24h reminder.

alex: Thanks everyone — closing the loop. I'll follow up with a short post in #eng today to surface to any other teams.
